description: This file contains utility functions for logging and managing data structures related to activation checkpointing in PyTorch's torch.fx graphs. It includes functions to generate graph node information, edges, detailed logging payloads, and structured traces for min-cut optimization analysis.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] create_joint_graph_node_information( joint_graph: Graph, recomputable_node_info: dict[str, int], )
methods.description: Generates a dictionary with detailed information about each node in the provided joint graph, including whether it's a recomputable candidate and related metadata.

methods.name: list[tuple[str,str]] create_joint_graph_edges(joint_graph: Graph)
methods.description: Constructs a list of tensor input-output edge pairs from the provided joint graph.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] create_activation_checkpointing_logging_structure_payload( joint_graph: Graph, joint_graph_node_information: dict[str, Any], joint_graph_edges: list[tuple[str, str]], all_recomputable_banned_nodes: list[Node], expected_runtime: float, saved_node_idxs: list[int], recomputable_node_idxs: list[int], memories_banned_nodes: list[int], normalized_memories_banned_nodes: list[float], runtimes_banned_nodes: list[float], min_cut_saved_values: list[Node], )
methods.description: Creates a structured payload (dictionary) containing detailed activation checkpointing information suitable for logging.

methods.name: None create_structured_trace_for_min_cut_info( joint_graph: Graph, all_recomputable_banned_nodes: list[Node], saved_node_idxs: list[int], recomputable_node_idxs: list[int], expected_runtime: float, memories_banned_nodes: list[int], normalized_memories_banned_nodes: list[float], runtimes_banned_nodes: list[float], min_cut_saved_values: list[Node], )
methods.description: Performs data processing and creates a structured trace for min-cut analysis of the graph, updating node info with memory and runtime data, and then logs it.
